open_issues.next: fix at the cleanup of the phase; fix idea: Minor, with a design choice. The design rule says an id with provides.cli routes to its CLI, and the current code deliberately excludes bridges. Either drop the kind != bridge filter in group_units so route and help include bridges that have provides.cli (orch-harness has an empty provides and stays unknown), or record the exclusion as an open_issue and amend the design. Regression check: add a test in scripts/test-umbrella.py with a fixture bridge that has provides.cli and assert the route execs <root>/<cli[0]> with the remaining args.

summary: F1 fixed. Bare `doctor` now reads the fan-out list from the new `doctor.fanout` field in configs/umbrella.json (skiller, harness, maind, analyst, in that order) and runs `<cli> doctor` only for those modules, with an `== id ==` header each. It no longer walks every unit with provides.doctor, so aicore, brain and orch are not called. A missing launcher prints `ERROR: package launcher not found` and sets exit 1, as the old bash did. umbrella.schema.json gained the `doctor` object. In scripts/test-umbrella.py, a new TestLegacyGroups test asserts the exact argv sequence and order, with brain and orch added to the fixture hub. The old fan-out test now checks the missing-launcher path. Tests run: scripts/test-umbrella.py (25 OK), scripts/test-dev-guard.py OK, golden.py check OK, test-config-inventory.py OK. The help text is unchanged, so the golden file did not change.
